Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. If you don't meet the conditions specified for "by X" in such an effect, the rest of the effect won't activate.
Card Q&A.q: If I have 0 security cards or if I don't add the top or bottom card of my security stack to the hand for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect, can I activate the part of the effect after "then"?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] By adding the top or bottom card of your security stack to the hand, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP for the turn. Then, you may place 1 Digimon card with the [Angel], [Archangel] or [Three Great Angels] trait from your hand at the bottom of your security stack.
Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn] All of your Digimon with the [Angel], [Archangel] or [Three Great Angels] trait gain ＜Blocker＞.
